title: Adding a product viewset: cochange of route, generated clients, MCP tools.yaml; logic guards for team id and shared views
answers: What files change when I add a new project-scoped endpoint in product_analytics?
Why does dataRetentionBannerLogic skip the request in shared dashboards?
Where do product viewsets get registered?
body:
Adding `EventsRetentionViewSet` required these to move together:
- Viewset lives under products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/ (reviewer moved it out of posthog/api) and registers in products/product_analytics/backend/routes.py via `routers.projects.register(...)`.
- Regenerate clients: products/product_analytics/frontend/generated/api.ts and api.schemas.ts, and services/mcp/src/api/generated.ts; do not hand-edit.
- Add the operation to products/product_analytics/mcp/tools.yaml (here `events-retention-retrieve` with `enabled: false`).
- Frontend logics calling the generated client with the team id: `loadRetentionMonths` in dataRetentionBannerLogic.ts returns null while `currentTeamId` is null, reloads on `teamLogic.actionTypes.loadCurrentTeamSuccess`, and skips the request when `isSharedView()` (shared/embedded pages).
applies: New project-scoped endpoints in products/product_analytics and logics consuming them
